sources.title: vLLM GitHub Gym: vLLM GitHub Snapshot (Fivetran)
sources.author: Simon Mo

query_layers.delta: delta_* tables preserve the normalized API delta and raw JSON
query_layers.canonical: canonical_* tables are deduplicated and materialized at the analysis cutoff
query_layers.metadata: dataset_* tables contain provenance, semantics, inventory, and validation

known_limitations: Text edited after the cutoff is the representation observed during the August collection and is flagged by representation_may_postdate_cutoff.
PR-level aggregate file coverage is available for delta-refreshed PRs; older per-commit file data remains in commit_file.
Open PR file lists that may include post-cutoff changes are flagged as unstable.
Commit timestamps do not reveal when a commit was first pushed to a pull request.
repo_collaborator is the May 18 roster, not a historical maintainer-membership table.
data_notice: The database contains public GitHub text, usernames, actor identifiers, and commit metadata including names and emails. It is not de-identified survey data. No new license is asserted over third-party GitHub content.
